title: GoozmisRP Reborn
description: There are many additional items in this resource pack. They can be obtained by renaming items.

![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d0197efb7e26323ee561c5adc796913847b1136.png)
# GoozmisRP Reborn
This resourcepack was made based on the mod from Terraria “Hunt of the Old God” and been redesigned and made into **3D models**! To get an item, you need to change it on the anvil.

## List of renames:
[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DhKCRK6Cv7rBr8O6W49vX_Z7m1pTQ3LlqLXajxs6hH0/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DhKCRK6Cv7rBr8O6W49vX_Z7m1pTQ3LlqLXajxs6hH0/edit?usp=sharing)

## Required Modifications:
[Optifine](https://optifine.net/home) or [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)
